meta.name: Rokar POS
meta.description: Rokar is a fast, offline-first billing & inventory POS for retail shops in Pakistan. Billing, udhaar (khata), stock audit, supplier tracking and reports -- all on one Windows app.
meta.ogTitle: Rokar POS -- Billing & Inventory for Pakistani Shops
meta.ogDescription: Offline-first POS with billing, udhaar khata, inventory, reports and thermal receipt printing. Built for small retail shops.

hero.eyebrow: Offline-First POS - Made for Pakistani Shops
hero.lead: Rokar is an offline-first billing & inventory app built specifically for retail dukaan owners. Scan barcodes, bill in seconds, track udhaar (khata), and see daily net profit -- bina internet ke.
hero.versionNote: Download free hai — koi card nahi, koi signup nahi. Ek baar licence khareedein, phir hamesha chalega.

features.eyebrow: Sab Kuch Ek Hi App Mein
features.lead: Rokar brings billing, stock, customer credit, and profit reports together -- replacing registers, lost udhaar pages, and mental math with records you can open and check yourself.

items.title: Fast Offline Billing
items.desc: Barcode scan ya 2-letter search se bill — poori tarah offline, kabhi internet ki zarurat nahi.

items.title: Udhaar / Khata Ledger
items.desc: Customer credit accounts with 'Kitna baqi hai' at a glance. 1-click WhatsApp balance reminders prevent lost money.

items.title: Inventory & Stock Audit
items.desc: Real-time stock deduction, low-stock warnings, and full stock audit tools to match physical shelf items with system ledger.

items.title: Thermal & A4 Receipts
items.desc: Instant printing on 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printers, barcode label generation, and elegant A4 tax invoices.

items.title: Purchases & Suppliers
items.desc: Record purchase bills, supplier dues, return vouchers, and track incoming stock costs with complete ledger history.

items.title: Daily Profit & Reports
items.desc: Today's sales, net profit, top-selling items, hourly rush trends, and monthly P&L exportable directly to Excel.

items.title: Multi-shift Cash Drawer
items.desc: Separate morning and evening cash drawers with end-of-shift cash counting. Know exactly how much each cashier collected.

items.title: Cashier & Owner Roles
items.desc: Owner, Manager, Cashier permissions. Cashiers can only bill; profit figures and sensitive settings stay locked for Owner only.

items.title: WhatsApp Digital Receipts
items.desc: Send itemized digital receipts straight to customer WhatsApp in 1 click. Saves thermal paper and looks ultra professional.

items.title: Daily Automatic Backup
items.desc: Har raat 2 baje aap ke folder mein backup banta hai. Agar woh folder OneDrive ya Google Drive ke andar ho to woh khud sync ho jaata hai. Backup encrypted nahi hota.

items.title: Wholesale & Retail Modes
items.desc: Retail price for walk-in customers, wholesale rate for bulk thok buyers -- switch instantly at billing in one tap.

items.title: Barcode Label Generator
items.desc: Design and print your own custom barcode stickers for unbranded items directly from Rokar POS to any label printer.

industries.name: Kirana & Superstores
industries.desc: Barcode checkout, har customer ka apna udhaar limit, aur stock khatam hone se pehle ki khabar.
points: Billing screen par hi barcode scan: scanner ka code aate hi product line me chala jata hai
Har customer ka apna udhaar limit — limit cross karne wala bill save nahi hota
Limit ka poora record: purani limit, nayi limit, kaun badla aur kyun
Low-stock threshold set karein — app alert de, dashboard par list banaye aur email bhi bheje

industries.name: Pharmacy & Medical
industries.desc: Batch number ke sath stock, expiry se pehle ki warning, aur supplier ka poora hisaab.
points: Expiry alert default 30 din pehle — jab 7 din ya kam bache to alert critical ho jata hai
Stock batch number ke sath: bill lagte waqt wahi batch pehle jaata hai jaldi expire hone wala
Supplier ledger: khareed, payment aur chal balance ek jagah
Supplier par bhi credit limit set kar sakte hain

industries.name: Bakery & Sweets
industries.desc: Toulay wale items, gram se box tak har unit ka apna rate, aur har shift ka alag closing.
points: Toulay wale item: weight daalein, rate per kg khud calculate ho jata hai
Weight screen par + ya - se 50 gram ka step, ya type karke seedha
Har unit ka apna price aur apna barcode: 500 Gram, 1 kg, aur poora box
Har cashier ka shift alag: opening cash, closing cash aur farq (variance) bhi

industries.name: Garments & Footwear
industries.desc: Size aur colour ke combination, apne barcode ki sticker, aur chal rahi promotion.
points: Size aur colour ki list daalein — app har combination khud bana deta hai (jaise 2 colour x 3 size = 6 variants)
Har variant ka apna barcode, apna MRP, apna rate aur apna stock
Barcode sticker printing: template chunein aur roll ka pitch (mm) bhi set karein
Promotion chala sakte hain: percent kam, fixed raam ya 2 kharido 1 free — product ya category aur date range ke sath
Return par maal wapas stock me chala jata hai, refund cash ya udhaar credit dono ho sakta hai

preview.v: Size x colour, khud ban jate hain

industries.name: Wholesale & Electronics
industries.desc: Wholesale aur retail ke alag rate, quotation se seedha bill, aur customer ka poora ledger.
points: Har product ka apna wholesale rate; bill par retail ya wholesale mode chun lein
Quotation bana kar bhej dein, customer ke manzil par baad me usi quotation se bill ban jata hai
Customer ledger: har bill, payment aur udhaar ka hisaab — paid ya pending ke hisaab se Excel export
Purchase order, supplier payment aur supplier ledger bhi isi app me

requirements.label: Internet
requirements.value: Optional — licence check, updates, WhatsApp receipts

faq.q: Internet nahi ho to billing ruk jati hai?
faq.a: Nahi. Billing, stock, reports aur backup -- sab aap ke PC par hote hain aur internet ke bina bhi chalte hain. Internet sirf pehli baar licence activate karne, licence verify karne aur naya update lene ke liye chahiye.

faq.q: Kya ek se zyada cashier use kar sakte hain?
faq.a: Pro aur Multi-Branch plans mein multiple cashier accounts hain with separate shift reports.

faq.q: Licence key daalne se mera data delete to nahi hoga?
faq.a: Nahi. Aap ka saara data (products, customers, bills) aap ke PC par ki pos.db file mein rehta hai. Licence key sirf app ki setting hai — wo aap ka koi product, bill ya customer record nahi chhooti.

faq.q: Setup mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
faq.a: 15 minute install, 30 minute product entry. Hum AnyDesk par free remote setup bhi dete hain.

faq.q: Mera data kahan rehta hai? Agar computer kharab ho jaye to?
faq.a: Poora data aap ke PC ke andar hi rehta hai. Har raat 2 baje app khud aap ke folder mein backup bana deti hai. Agar woh folder OneDrive ya Google Drive ke  andar ho, to woh khud sync ho jaata hai — iske liye app ko internet nahi chahiye.

faq.q: Kya yeh mobile ya tablet par bhi chalega?
faq.a: Rokar Windows PC ke liye hai (Windows 10/11). Mobile ka istemaal receipt bhejne ke liye hota hai -- har bill 1-click mein customer ke WhatsApp par chala jaata hai.

faq.q: Invoice aur receipt kis tarah banti hai?
faq.a: Receipt English mein aati hai. Alag se A4 tax invoice bhi banta hai jo wholesale aur udhaar ke billon ke liye use hota hai.

faq.q: Licence ka masla hai? Kya har saal paisa dena parta hai?
faq.a: Nahi. Aik baar payment ke baad licence lifetime chalta hai — koi expiry date nahi, koi renewal nahi. Bas wohi PC chalayein jis par pehli baar activate kiya gaya tha; har package ki apni PC limit hoti hai.

faq.q: Agar owner ka password bhool jaye to?
faq.a: Aap ek baar security question set kar lein, phir login screen par 'Forgot password?' se khud naya password rakh lein. Saath hi aik recovery code bhi milta hai jo note kar ke rakhein. Koi aur option ho to hum support code se madad kar dete hain.

faq.q: Update ke liye baar baar download karna padega?
faq.a: Nahi. App khud update check karta hai. Naya version aate hi andar se notification aa jaati hai aur ek click mein update ho jata hai.

changelog.title: One-time licence — ab koi renewal nahi
notes: Ek baar payment ke baad licence lifetime chalta hai: koi expiry date nahi, har saal renewal fee nahi.
Licence us PC par activate hoti hai jis par shuru ki thi. Har package ki apni PC limit hai (1, 3 ya 5) — pehle ye limit kaam nahi karti thi, ab server par hamesha enforce hoti hai.
Server se licence revoke karne par agli sale se app band ho jata hai. Licence dobara activate karne se shuru ho jaati hai.

changelog.title: Password Recovery — koi bhi khud password reset kar le
notes: Security question set karein, phir 'Forgot password?' se khud naya password rakhein
Ek recovery code bhi milta hai — wo note kar lein, agar security question bhool jayein
Support ke liye: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R se Device ID dikhata hai, support code se unlock
5 galat koshishon ke baad 10 minute ka lock — koi guess nahi kar sakta

changelog.title: Reliable Printing — 58mm/80mm receipts, invoices aur labels
notes: 58mm aur 80mm dono paper par sahi receipts, A4/A5 invoices
Roll aur sheet barcode label printing, har slot ka apna printer
Narrow paper par receipt ka table do line mein toot-ta hai — ab sahi chalta hai
A4 par koi column kat nahi hota (automatic layout audit)

changelog.title: Stock Audit & Margin Engine
notes: Naya Stock Audit engine — physical dukan aur system ledger ka foran milaan
Margin aur net profit percent P&L report me, aur kam-margin products ki alert
Bill print ho ya WhatsApp dono par — customer ke number par foran
Printed receipt, invoice aur label par shop ka logo
